trigger.finding: Black square artifacts are already present in the raw 1600x900 clean capture before any offline corruption or resize.

conditions.meaning: rejected bakeoff clean profile reproduced exactly

controlled_variables: same Route151 XML and route-native weather
same CARLA server process and Vulkan runtime

decision_rule.none_clean_intensity_clean_triple_bad: The multi-attribute clean override is causal; retire it and use unmodified blueprint as clean.
decision_rule.none_clean_intensity_bad: Even a zero-intensity override is unsafe in this runtime; never write zero-valued native motion-blur attributes for clean.
decision_rule.none_bad: The issue precedes the motion-blur patch; inspect CARLA runtime, server logs, weather/material state, and GPU before any corruption work.
decision_rule.all_clean: The prior failure was intermittent; repeat the unmodified baseline on a second job before release.

claim_boundary: Engineering root-cause diagnostic only. No condition is a released corruption and no safety outcome may be used.
